decisions_for_conductor: vfdiv/vfdiv.r/vfsqrt (.h and .ah, 10 instrs) are defined with GVSoC encodings because the task lists them, but GAP9 GNU as rejects them; drop those defs if GNU as is authoritative (design Q9).

Not defined: fmv.x.ah/fmv.ah.x, vfmv.*, vfcpkb.* (GNU as rejects; GVSoC gates vfcpkb on D), Xf8/.b, Xfaux (vfdotp*, vfavg, fmulex.s.ah, fmacex.s.ah - GNU as accepts the last two but task excludes Xfaux), RV64 fcvt.l*.ah.
Vector .h ops gated on Xpulpfvec+Zhinx, .ah ops on Xpulpfvec+Xpulpf16alt (design 6.3 / GVSoC f16vec,f16altvec tags); scalar fcvt.h.ah/ah.h and vfcvt.h.ah/ah.h also need Zhinx.
Aliases fneg/fabs/fgt/fge.ah and vfneg/vfabs.h/.ah are parse-only so llvm-objdump prints like GNU objdump.
Sched<[]> like Snitch defs; T3/T5 should add real sched classes. No Uses=[FRM] on vfcvt.x.h (GVSoC rounds with frm) - T5 should decide.
other_errors_seen: GVSoC model bug (not LLVM): gvsoc2 isa_smallfloats.py swaps vfsgnj.ah (listed funct3 101) and vfsgnj.r.ah (001); GNU as encodes vfsgnj.ah with 001. GVSoC runs vfsgnj.ah as vfsgnj.r.ah - affects future v2ah copysign GVSoC checks (T5/T6).
